material.title: Synthetic FMS airworthiness notice
material.bodyOriginal: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. The fictional authority issued AD TEST-001 for fictional FMS version 1.2 on aircraft TEST-A. Operators must install software 1.3 within 30 days to correct misleading lateral guidance under the stated test conditions.

material.title: Airline discount travel promotion
material.bodyOriginal: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Buy cheap airline tickets and hotel packages this week. No avionics, flight management or navigation changes are discussed.
